info.description: Speech-to-speech model for real-time voice agents. grok-voice-latest points to this model, and grok-voice-2.0 is deprecated at the same price. Audio is billed at $0.08 per minute ($4.80 per hour). Each text conversation.item.create costs $0.004, except function_call_output items and items whose content is audio. Sessions using server_vad are billed for session duration; push-to-talk sessions are billed only for audio sent and received. reasoning.effort defaults to high; none turns reasoning off. The model page lists us-east-1, eu-west-1, and us-saltlake-2.

zh.description: 用于实时语音智能体的语音到语音模型。grok-voice-latest 指向该模型，grok-voice-2.0 已弃用且价格相同。音频按每分钟 $0.08（每小时 $4.80）计费。每条文本 conversation.item.create 为 $0.004，function_call_output 以及内容为音频的条目除外。使用 server_vad 的会话按会话时长计费；按键说话的会话只按发出和收到的音频计费。reasoning.effort 默认为 high，none 关闭推理。模型页列出 us-east-1、eu-west-1 与 us-saltlake-2。
